about: Multi-turn follow-up scenarios for the dashboard chat. Times are minutes relative to the test clock (2026-10-30T08:00:00Z, 16:00 MYT). Each turn sends its message with the context the previous reply returned, unless the turn gives context_from (an incident offset, as a choice chip would) or context null. expect lists the facts the reply must state; context_start is the offset of the incident the returned context points at, null for none; context_unchanged means the reply returned the context it was sent.
